name: court-skill-with-refinement
description: The court skill for Claude Code, with a founder/arbiter refinement loop

plugins.name: court-refine
plugins.description: Puts your idea on trial (prosecutor, defense, a jury of up to 12 Claudes, a judge), then optionally lets a founder refine and defend it until the jury acquits and the judge agrees, or an arbiter rules it exhausted.
